_comment: Chapter photography provenance. The first six photographs were supplied by the chapter e-board on 2026-08-12; the second batch came from sixty masters supplied on 2026-09-05. The original triage and masters remain in Git history at f680563 under assets-src/. Stacked Up Summit professional photographs are credited to Chloe Jackman Photography and were approved by the chapter for website use on 2026-09-06. Northrop photographs are a styled board photoshoot, not snapshots of a meeting. Source-level credits and permissions also apply to the generated responsive variants.

responsiveImages.policy: Keep original aspect ratio and stop at source width. Browser sizes/srcset selects one suitable asset; no upscaling or runtime optimization server. Run npm run images:build after changing a source photo.
responsiveImages.audit: Official chapter GopherLink photo page and LinkedIn were reviewed; the chapter-supplied collection offers appropriate, approved imagery at higher source quality. No unrelated stock or generated member photography was added.

notAudited: The summit-group-1600.webp photograph is retained for the page's social sharing metadata.

The board photoshoot at Northrop photographs are an editorial shoot, not meeting-night candids. The gallery is now titled 'A few moments, together.' to describe the mixed campus and conference collection accurately.

Individuals are named in several master filenames in assets-src/photos/UMNSTACKEDUP/. No name appears in any alt text or in this file, but these are prominent, repeated, close-up appearances of a small number of people and the chapter should be sure each of them agreed to be on the public site.
